appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Configure theme, UI text size, and language preference so DashPlayer fits your workflow.
appearance.cardDescription: Customize your color theme, interface language, and subtitle font sizes.
appearance.themeDescription: Choose between dark and light appearance. Changes take effect immediately.
appearance.fontSizeDescription: Adjust interface text size to balance reading comfort and information density.
appearance.subtitlePreviewHint: (Live preview of the selected font size in player)
appearance.subtitlePreviewSampleEn: Every journey begins with a single bold step.
appearance.subtitlePreviewSampleZh: 每一个伟大的旅程，都始于勇敢迈出的第一步。
appearance.languageDescription: Follow your system language by default, or lock to Chinese/English for stable terminology.

proxy.title: Network Proxy
proxy.description: Configure the network proxy used by the app: follow system proxy or set a custom one.
proxy.modeDescription: Follow system reads OS proxy settings; Custom requires a proxy URL; No proxy connects directly.
proxy.urlDescription: Supports http://, https:// and socks5:// protocols.
proxy.bypassRulesDescription: Comma-separated domains/IPs/CIDRs that bypass the proxy (e.g., localhost, 127.0.0.1).

shortcut.title: Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Customize keyboard shortcuts for playback, subtitles, and tools. Supports multiple keybindings per action.

groups.playbackDesc: Control video playback, loop repetitions, and navigation.
groups.subtitlesDesc: Toggle English, Chinese, and word-level highlighted subtitles.
groups.timingDesc: Fine-tune start and end timestamps for the current sentence.
groups.toolsDesc: Trigger AI assistant, save favorite clips, and open control panel.

shortcut.dialogDescription: Press key combinations directly on your keyboard, then click Save.
shortcut.dialogNoShortcuts: No shortcuts bound (record above to add)

playPause.description: Toggle playback between play and pause.

autoPause.title: Auto-pause
autoPause.description: Pause automatically after each subtitle line.

toggleBilingualDisplay.title: Toggle Bilingual Subtitles
toggleBilingualDisplay.description: Switch bilingual subtitle display on or off.

toggleWordLevelDisplay.title: Toggle Word-Level Subtitles
toggleWordLevelDisplay.description: Switch word-level highlighted subtitles on or off.

clearAdjust.title: Reset Subtitle Timing
clearAdjust.description: Restore subtitle timing offsets to default.

addClip.title: Add Favorite Clip
addClip.description: Bookmark current sentence segment to Saved Clips.

about.slogan: The intelligent bilingual media player built for language learners
about.description: DashPlayer combines on-device offline speech recognition with modern LLMs to help you master languages through real video content.
about.appInfoDescription: Explore DashPlayer version and feature highlights
about.resourcesDescription: Read documentation, report issues, or contribute

features.asrDesc: Built-in neural ASR model generates bilingual subtitles in seconds without network connections.
features.aiDesc: Breaks down complex sentences and grammar rules with rich context and authentic pronunciations.
features.listenDesc: Supports single-line looping, AB repeating, auto-pausing, and clip bookmarking.
features.privacyDesc: Vocabulary notes, transcription history, and saved clips stay completely on your machine.

links.docsDesc: Explore tutorials, workflows, and shortcut guides
links.githubDesc: Submit issues, suggest features, or star the project

storage.title: Storage
storage.descriptionLine1: DashPlayer caches translation results locally to reduce API costs.
storage.descriptionLine2: Cache is managed automatically. Manual modifications are not recommended.
storage.resetConfirmDescription: This clears all database records and restarts the app. Saved and vocabulary clips will be rebuilt from local files on restart; other data will be lost. This cannot be undone.
storage.libraryPathDescription: Restart DashPlayer for storage path changes to take effect.
storage.syncWordClipsFailed: Failed to sync Vocabulary Studio clips. Please try again later.

collectionSync.tooltipDescription: Rebuild the Saved Clips index from local files when items look missing or inconsistent.

storage.collectionHint: Saved Clips are stored under favourite_clips/default. Custom folder names are not currently supported.

wordClipsSync.error: Failed to sync Vocabulary Studio clips.
wordClipsSync.tooltipDescription: Rebuild Vocabulary Studio clip records from the word_video folder when data is missing or corrupted.

storage.wordClipsHint: Vocabulary Studio clips are stored under word_video. Use this action to rebuild database records if needed.

usage.title: Storage Usage
usage.unavailable: Storage directory unavailable. Usage cannot be measured.
usage.empty: No files are using storage space yet.

storage.openFailed: Failed to open the cache folder

openai.autoAppendV1Hint: When enabled, /v1 is automatically appended to the base URL. Disable if your URL already includes /v1.
openai.chatCompletionOnly: Only the chat completion API format is supported.
openai.usedByHint: Models currently in use by features cannot be deleted.

localAi.useSuccess: Switched to this model; local translation and dictionary now share it
localAi.deleteConfirmDescription: This frees up local disk space; you can download or import it again anytime.
localAi.runtimeMissing: The local enhancement pack component is missing; please reinstall the app.
localAi.customGuideTitle: Download not working? See the manual import guide
localAi.customGuideStep1: Download an instruct-tuned GGUF model file (Qwen series recommended; Q4_K_M offers the best balance of size and quality).
localAi.customGuideStep3: Once the file is in place, come back to the app — the new model appears in the list automatically. Click "Use" to enable it.

resources.title: Services & Resources
resources.description: Download the resources needed to run locally, and install the local enhancement pack or connect cloud services as needed.

pack.title: Local base resource pack
pack.description: Pronunciation, subtitle recognition and lightweight translation — install once and use offline.
pack.deleteConfirmTitle: Delete the local base resource pack?
pack.deleteConfirmDescription: You will need to download it again before using it. Delete anyway?
pack.downloaded: Local base resource pack is ready
pack.itemTtsDesc: Reads words and example sentences aloud.
pack.itemTranscriptionDesc: Recognizes speech in videos and generates subtitles.
pack.itemMtDesc: Offline subtitle translation with a literal style.
pack.manualTitle: Slow network? See the manual download guide
pack.mtFiles: All files in the repository (including the onnx subfolder), keeping the original folder structure
pack.step3Hint: Once the file is in place, come back and click "Download all" above — the app verifies and installs it for you.

preference.title: Translation & Lookup Preferences
preference.description: Which resource handles subtitle translation and dictionary lookups, and the translation style.
preference.dictionaryDesc: The built-in dictionary covers 38,000 common words, so lookups work without any setup. This setting only decides what to use for words it does not cover.
preference.stylePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default style…
preference.localMtZhOnlyHint: Lightweight translation only supports translating into Chinese.
preference.notReadyHint: The selected resource is not downloaded yet. Download the local base resource pack above first.
preference.sentenceDesc: Press the shortcut to open an explanation panel for the current sentence, covering grammar and usage.
preference.cacheDesc: Clears cached subtitle translations and lookups produced by the current configuration; they will be requested again next time.

cloud.title: Cloud Services
cloud.description: Builds on the local base resource pack, using cloud models for the best translation and lookup quality; a provider key is required.

enhance.title: Local enhancement resource pack
enhance.description: Builds on the local base resource pack for more natural translation and lookups. A nice-to-have — install it when you want the extra polish.
enhance.hardwareHintGpu: This machine is a good fit for the local enhancement pack: {{memory}} GB RAM, {{cores}} CPU cores, {{gpu}} acceleration.
enhance.hardwareHintNoGpu: This machine can run the local enhancement pack, but only on CPU, so it will be slower ({{memory}} GB RAM, {{cores}} CPU cores).
enhance.hardwareHintLowSpec: This machine is short on memory; the local enhancement pack may not run well ({{memory}} GB RAM, {{cores}} CPU cores).
enhance.deleteConfirmTitle: Delete the local enhancement resource pack?
